item.title: Zelensky proposes sending Ukrainian drone experts to Middle East in ceasefire push
item.description: "I would suggest the following: leaders of the Middle East have great relations with Russians. They can ask Russians to implement a month-long ceasefire," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

item.title: 'This issue concerns us' — Zelensky warns Middle East war could strain Ukraine air defense supplies
item.description: Zelensky said Ukraine has seen no signs of a PAC-3 interceptor shortage so far, but warned that a prolonged Middle East war and intense fighting could strain air defense supplies.

item.title: Macron unveils expansion of France’s nuclear arsenal, opens door to European deterrence cooperation
item.description: Speaking at the L’Île Longue naval base in northwestern France — home to the country’s ballistic missile submarines — Macron argued that Europe must assume a more autonomous role in its own defense amid Russia’s war against Ukraine and shifting U.S. strategic priorities.

item.title: IPC bars Ukrainian team from wearing uniform featuring map of Ukraine at Winter Paralympics
item.description: The International Paralympic Committee barred Ukraine’s Paralympic team from wearing their ceremonial uniform for the upcoming Winter Games, saying the design featuring a map of Ukraine was political, according to National Paralympic Committee President Valerii Sushkevych.

item.title: 'Wars can be fought forever’: Trump claims US has ‘virtually unlimited’ weapons stockpile
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on March 2 that U.S. munitions stockpiles are stronger than ever, stating in a post on Truth Social that supplies at the medium and upper-medium levels have “never been higher or better” and that the country has a “virtually unlimited supply of these weapons.”
